---
name: Feature, pipeline, bug or research task
about: Scoped work item with acceptance criteria
labels: []
---

## Problem / outcome
Why does this matter? What will improve if it works?

## Inputs and evidence
Authoritative paths, versions, schemas, logs, exact observed behavior.

## Scope
Allowed files/modules/services and explicitly excluded areas.

## Proposed approach
Minimum implementation steps; major tradeoffs / design decisions.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable output 1
- [ ] Correctness/data-quality check 2
- [ ] Reproducibility / rollback check 3
- [ ] Tests and docs updated

## Dependencies and risks
Owner, prerequisites, data leakage, cost, security, compatibility.

## Deliverables
Exact code/config/report/notebook/artifact names and expected review state.
